title: Specimen Tag
object: Hard enamel pin, 32 mm, brass plating, rubber clutch. Stamped edition of 1,000.
wall_label: Specimen tags were once tied to the toe of an object, not a body. The tag outlived the specimen in most collections. Curators kept the number and lost the thing. This is the standard Memecrypt tag: catalogue number, classification, and a provenance field that has never once been filled in honestly.

notes.Provenance: Origin unknown. Acquired from a group chat. No prior owner has come forward.

shop_copy: Wear the number, not the meme.
